examples.arabic: هو افتكر اللي حصل امبارح وسأل عن اخواته واحلامه الكبيرة
examples.english: He remembered what happened yesterday and asked about his siblings and his big dreams
examples.transliteration: Howa eftakar elli hasal embareh we sa-al an akhwato we ahlamo el kabira
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: حاولت أتابع الوصفة كويس بس مش عارف إيه اللي حصل
examples.english: I tried to follow the recipe well but I don't know what happened.
examples.transliteration: Hawwalt atabe' el wasfa kwayyes bas mesh aref eih elli hasal.

examples.arabic: قومت اشوف ايه اللي حصل بالظبط
examples.english: I got up to see exactly what happened.
examples.transliteration: ʔumt ashūf ēh illi ḥaṣal biẓ-ẓabṭ.

examples.arabic: هي بدأت تتكلم بصوت عالي ايه اللي حصل امبارح بالليل كان ازعاج رهيب
examples.english: She started talking loudly: "What happened last night was terrible noise!"
examples.transliteration: Hiyya bada't tetkallem besot 'ali: "Eh elli hasal embarah bel-leil kan ez'ag rahib!"

examples.arabic: حصل موقف محرج لما حاول يلبس جاكت كان صغير عليه
examples.english: An embarrassing situation happened when he tried to wear a jacket that was too small for him.
examples.transliteration: Ḥaṣal mawqeif muḥreg lamma ḥáwal yelbes gāket kān ṣoghayyar ʻaléih.
